name: 1-coggle-faithful
_why: The measured Coggle tree grammar, as is: grey box root, pastel ribbon per branch with text in the same hue darkened, right-aligned labels riding the trunk into a notched junction, bracket fans to pointed tips. The baseline Rufus already likes, so the other options can be judged as departures from it.
description: Faithful Coggle tree (measured): grey root box, pastel ribbons, labels above/below the trunk end, notched junction, bracket fans, font step 0.86, no bold except the lead.
